data.name: Aymaan
data.gender_notes: Aymaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who sells fish. The name Aymaan carries the meaning “Fisherman” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aymaan usually hope their child will grow to embody fisherman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A protector, a provider, a faithful servant of Allah
data.etymology: Aymaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fisherman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aymaan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: أيمان
in_arabic.long_meaning: أيمان في الإسلام هو الحلف الأقدس بين الله و بين عباده، و هو الموعد الأوحد الذي يقرع به القلب و يثبت به الحق. و هو الوسيلة الأساسية للوصول إلى القرب من الله و للنجاح في الحياة. و يعتبر الحلف الأقدس في الإسلام وسيلة قوية للتعامل مع التحديات و للأمانة في جميع المواقف. و هو أيضاً وسيلة للتعاون و التعاون بين الناس، و لتعزيز روح الجماعة و العلاقات الإنسانية. و يعتبر الحلف الأقدس في الإسلام من أهم العهود في الإسلام و من أهم ما يجب على المسلمين أن يلتزموا به. و هو أيضاً وسيلة للتقرب من الله و للوصول إلى الرضا الحق.

in_urdu.name: ایمان
in_urdu.meaning: اسلام میں ایمان کا حلف اور ایک ہی معاہدہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسلام میں ایمان کا حلف ایک مقدس عہد ہے جو اللہ اور اس کے بندوں کے درمیان ہوتا ہے، اور یہ ایک ہی معاہدہ ہوتا ہے جس کے ذریعے دل کو صاف کیا جاتا ہے اور حق کا ثبوت ہوتا ہے۔ یہ اسلام میں کامیابی کے لیے ایک اہم ذریعہ ہے جسے اللہ سے قریبی تعلق قائم کرنے کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔ یہ ہر موضع میں امانتدار کے لیے بھی ایک قوی ذریعہ ہے، اور یہ لوگوں کے مابین تعاون اور تعاون کو فروغ دیتا ہے، اور انساني تعلقات کو فروغ دیتا ہے۔ اسلام میں ایمان کا حلف ایک اہم عہد ہے جس پر مسلمانوں کو پابند ہونا چاہیے۔

in_hindi.name: आयमान
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लाम में सच्चाई का संकल्प और एक ही समझौता
in_hindi.long_meaning: इस्लाम में आयमान एक पवित्र वादा है जो अल्लाह और उसके भक्तों के बीच होता है, और यह एक ही समझौता होता है जिसके माध्यम से दिल को साफ किया जाता है और सत्य का प्रमाण होता है। यह इस्लाम में सफलता के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण साधन है, जिसे अल्लाह से निकटता प्राप्त करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है। यह हर स्थिति में ईमानदारी के लिए एक शक्तिशाली साधन है, और यह लोगों के बीच सहयोग और सहयोग को बढ़ावा देता है, और मानव संबंधों को बढ़ावा देता है। इस्लाम में आयमान एक महत्वपूर्ण वादा है जिस पर मुसलमानों को बाध्य रहना चाहिए।

in_english.name: Aymaan
in_english.meaning: The sacred oath of faith and a single promise in Islam, symbolizing trust, loyalty, and devotion to Allah.
in_english.long_meaning: Aymaan in Islam is the sacred oath between Allah and His servants, symbolizing trust, loyalty, and devotion to Allah. It is the fundamental way to achieve closeness to Allah and success in life. It is also the means to deal with challenges and maintain integrity in all situations. Aymaan is also the means to promote cooperation and unity among people, and to strengthen the spirit of community and human relationships. In Islam, Aymaan is a significant promise that Muslims should abide by. It is also a means to attain spiritual growth and closeness to Allah.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Aymaan" holds a significant cultural connection to the traditional fishing communities in the Islamic world. Masters of their trade, these individuals spent their lives at sea, braving the elements in pursuit of their livelihood. The naming of a child as "Aymaan" would serve as a source of pride within these communities, heralding a respectable and noble profession.
data.spiritual_significance: In a broader context, the name "Aymaan" holds deep spiritual significance. It serves as a constant reminder of God's bounty and the interconnectedness of all living beings. Additionally, the Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him) is reported to have said, "There is a blessing attached to everything that Allah has created, and a cure, so look for the blessings in it, and seek help and means to benefit from it." Fishing, as a means of livelihood, would be considered one such blessing from Allah, making the name "Aymaan" a source of inspiration and encouragement for the bearer to seek Allah's blessings in all aspects of their life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Aymaan signifies the one who is a trustworthy guardian or protector. It symbolizes faithfulness, reliability, and responsibility in safeguarding values and commitments. Aymaan is a reflection of the belief that every believer holds a position of trust and accountability in their community and before Allah.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa'l-Nihayah records that Aymaan ibn Harith was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who excelled in delivering sermons and reciting the Quran. He was also known for his generosity and piety.
historical_references.context: Biographical account of a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)

historical_references.reference: Al-Baladhuri's Ansab Al-Ashraf mentions Aymaan ibn Ubayd Allah as a commander of the Muslim army during the reign of Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab (r. 634-644 AD). He led the Muslim forces against the Byzantines in Syria and was killed in battle near Emesa (modern Homs).
historical_references.context: Military commander during the Islamic conquests under Caliph Umar ibn Al-Khattab (r. 634-644 AD)
